1 · Headline signals (anatomy-matched & tissue-level, Mann-Whitney + Cliff's δ)

The story that survives scrutiny: chemical fixation doesn't just shrink ECS — it reshapes membrane topography, and the effect is tissue-specific.

SignalGroupp (MW)Cliff's δDirectionReading
Membrane roughness (30/60/120nm) & |H| stdCortex0.0025−1.00HPF>ChemHPF preserves rougher, more convoluted membranes — chem smooths them
Convex fractionCortex0.0025−1.00HPF>ChemChem flattens membranes into concave/flat profiles
Concave + flat fractionCortex0.0051+0.94Chem>HPF
Gap width p25–p75, contacts <40/80nmCortex0.018–0.048±0.71–0.83Chem: more contactsChem collapses gaps → artificial cell-cell contacts
SA:VLiver0.030+0.55Chem>HPFSurvives resolution-matching (matched 8nm)
Protrusion / indentation densityLiver0.009 / 0.025+0.65 / +0.57Chem>HPFCandidate "correlate of difference" for liver
ECS%, SA:V, cells/µm³, concavityBile canaliculus0.057*±1.00Chem>HPF*p-floor at n=4v4 — perfect separation; report δ + CI, not p
|H| stdKidney0.022−0.76HPF>ChemKidney direction still splits by region — lead with matched groups

Caveats logged in sanity-check: bile-canaliculus p sits at the exact-test floor for n=4v4 (framing fixed in 69b865f); pooled tissue medians are confounded by uneven anatomy — anatomy-matched groups are the reliable read. Kidney bm-sensitivity recompute exists (results/kidney_bm_sensitivity.csv).

3 · Decisions for Monday

D1 · Fig 2 region picks. Two anatomical areas per tissue. Candidates with matched n on both arms: liver = bile canaliculus + hepatocyte-lateral; kidney = glomerular interstitium + tubule basal infoldings; heart = interstitial + intercalated disc (heart HPF now makes these possible). Flag any n=1 arm.
D2 · What "correlate of difference" means per tissue. Proposal: liver = protrusion/indentation density (p=0.009); cortex = roughness + artificial contacts (p=0.0025); heart = caveolae (Albert); kidney = report bm-sensitivity-bounded ECS% instead?
D3 · Cortex framing. Cortex is "the benchmark" in Fig 1 — but it now carries the strongest topology signals in the dataset. Does any of that move into Fig 2, or stay out per the Fig-1-owns-brain split?
D4 · Bile-canaliculus stats framing. n=4v4 perfect separation → p floors at 0.057. Agree on reporting effect size + bootstrap CI rather than leaning on p.
D6 · Rehost the 3D membrane viewer. The interactive mesh viewer (456MB, 165 glb models) lives only on Aubrey's disk + cellmap-vm1 — a Janelia dependency that will break. Proposal: copy to the UCSD/SDSC hosting next to the kidney-4 zarr (it's self-contained HTML+JS+glb). Stopgap: Dropbox.
D5 · X-ray fallback. If John/registration doesn't land: supplement ppt slides + upload raw X-rays (per 8/20 notes). Decide the trigger date.
